description: Consult the configured memory backend before acting on a turn.
_comment_clients: Executables permitted to carry out this prerequisite. A shell command qualifies only if it is a single simple command whose argv[0] is one of these. Anything compound goes through the wrapper.
_comment_endpoints: Hosts and ports that ARE the dependency. Matching on the configured endpoint, not on a project name appearing in the command text, is what fixes INCIDENT-1b: a genuine query was blocked for lacking a magic substring, which also pressured agents into injecting that substring into semantic search strings.
_comment_mcp: MCP tool names, by what they do. Reading satisfies; writing does not.
_comment_capture: Endpoint paths that write rather than read. Permitted, never satisfying.
_comment_filters: Evidence that a query filters rather than dumping. Applied to the query ARGUMENT, never to the raw shell string.
_comment_expect: Response shape required to confirm a real consultation. A non-error exit is not enough on its own -- Incident 2 was a well-formed HTTP 200 carrying a failure.
